    function resetDropdownStyle(elem) {
        var e;
        if ("string" == typeof (elem))
            e = document.getElementById(elem);
        else
            e = elem;

        for (var i = 0, limit = e.options.length; i < limit; i++) {
            e.options[0].text = "--- Select State ---";
        }
    }
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
/*properties
    Abbreviation, Name, ajax, autoFill, autocomplete, click, contentType, data, dataType, error, focus, is, item, minLength, ready, select, source, success, type, url, useNative, val, value, watermark
*/
    //jQuery.noConflict();
    var $ = jQuery.noConflict();
    (function ($) {
        $(document).ready(function () {
            "use strict";
            $('#StatesDropdown_txtautofromDB').watermark(' Select State... ', { useNative: false });
            var $source, $type, $data;
            $source = $("[id$='HiddenFieldDataSource']").val();
            $type = $("[id$='HiddenFieldDisplayType']").val();
            $data = "{'dataSource' : '" + $source + "', 'displayType' : '" + $type + "' }";
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST",
                url: "../../AjaxBridge.aspx/GetStates",
                dataType: "json",
                data: $data,
                //appendTo: '#accontainer',
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function (data) {
                    var datafromServer = data.d || data;
                    if ($("[id$='PanelTextBox']").is(":visible")) {
                        $("[id$='txtautofromDB']").autocomplete({
                            minLength: 0,
                            source: datafromServer,
                            autoFill: true,
                            focus: function (event, ui) {
                                $("[id$='txtautofromDB']").val(ui.item.Name);
                                return false;
                            },
                            select: function (event, ui) {
                                $("[id$='txtautofromDB']").val(ui.item.Name);
                                $("[id$='HiddenFieldselectedValue']").val(ui.item.Abbreviation);
                                $("[id$='HiddenFieldselectedItem']").val(ui.item.Name);
                                return false;
                            }
                        });

                        $("[id$='txtautofromDB']").on("blur", function (event) {
                            var autocomplete = $(this).data("autocomplete");
                            var matcher = new RegExp("^" + $.ui.autocomplete.escapeRegex($(this).val()) + "$", "i");
                            autocomplete.widget().children(".ui-menu-item").each(function () {
                                //Check if each autocomplete item is a case-insensitive match on the input
                                var item = $(this).data("item.autocomplete");
                                if (matcher.test(item.label || item.value || item)) {
                                    //There was a match, lets stop checking
                                    autocomplete.selectedItem = item;
                                    return;
                                }
                            });
                            //if there was a match trigger the select event on that match
                            //I would recommend matching the label to the input in the select event
                            if (autocomplete.selectedItem) {
                                autocomplete._trigger("select", event, {
                                    item: autocomplete.selectedItem
                                });
                                //there was no match, clear the input
                            } else {
                                $(this).val('');
                            }
                        });

                    }

                    $("[id$='txtautofromDB']").click(function () {
                        $(this).autocomplete("search", this.value);
                    });

                    if ($("[id$='PanelCustomControl']").is(":visible")) {
                        $("[id$='TextBoxCustomControl']").autocomplete({
                            minLength: 0,
                            source: data,
                            autoFill: true,
                            focus: function (event, ui) {
                                $("[id$='TextBoxCustomControl']").val(ui.item.Name);
                                return false;
                            },
                            select: function (event, ui) {
                                $("[id$='TextBoxCustomControl']").val(ui.item.Name);
                                $("[id$='HiddenFieldselectedValue']").val(ui.item.Abbreviation);
                                $("[id$='HiddenFieldselectedItem']").val(ui.item.Name);
                                return false;
                            }
                        });

                        $("[id$='TextBoxCustomControl']").on("blur", function (event) {
                            var autocomplete = $(this).data("autocomplete");
                            var matcher = new RegExp("^" + $.ui.autocomplete.escapeRegex($(this).val()) + "$", "i");
                            autocomplete.widget().children(".ui-menu-item").each(function () {
                                //Check if each autocomplete item is a case-insensitive match on the input
                                var item = $(this).data("item.autocomplete");
                                if (matcher.test(item.label || item.value || item)) {
                                    //There was a match, lets stop checking
                                    autocomplete.selectedItem = item;
                                    return;
                                }
                            });
                            //if there was a match trigger the select event on that match
                            //I would recommend matching the label to the input in the select event
                            if (autocomplete.selectedItem) {
                                autocomplete._trigger("select", event, {
                                    item: autocomplete.selectedItem
                                });
                                //there was no match, clear the input
                            } else {
                                $(this).val('');
                            }
                        });

                        $("[id$='TextBoxCustomControl']").click(function () {
                            $(this).autocomplete("search", this.value);
                        });
                    }
                },
                error: function (XMLHttpRequest, textStatus, errorThrown) {
                    alert(textStatus);
                }
            });
        });
    } (jQuery));

    function showStates() {
        var _thisElement = 'StatesDropdown_TextBoxCustomControl';
        document.getElementById(_thisElement).click();
    }
</script>

<script src="jscript/jquery.qtip.min.js" type="text/javascript"></script>
<script type="text/javascript">
        var autoRoloutEnabled = true;
        var $ = jQuery.noConflict();
        (function ($) {
            $(document).ready(function () {
                var stateInput = $('#StatesDropdown_txtautofromDB');
                var inmateInput = $('#inmateIDTextBox');
                inmateInput.watermark('Enter Inmate ID #', { useNative: false });
                inmateInput.val('');
                stateInput.val('');

                $(document).click(function () {
                    if (inmateInput != null)
                        inmateInput.qtip('hide');

                    if (stateInput != null)
                        stateInput.qtip('hide');
                });

                inmateInput.focus(function () {
                    inmateInput.qtip('destroy');
                    stateInput.qtip('destroy');
                });

                stateInput.focus(function () {
                    inmateInput.qtip('destroy');
                    stateInput.qtip('destroy');
                });

                $("#rolloverButtonMoney").hover(
                    function () {
                        autoRoloutEnabled = false;
                        setRollover(true, false, false, false);
                    },
                    function () {
                        setRollover(true, false, false, false);
                        autoRoloutEnabled = true;
                    }
                );
                $("#rolloverButtonMail").hover(
                    function () {
                        autoRoloutEnabled = false;
                        setRollover(false, true, false, false);
                    },
                    function () {
                        setRollover(true, false, false, false);
                        autoRoloutEnabled = true;
                    }
                );
                $("#rolloverButtonVideo").hover(
                    function () {
                        autoRoloutEnabled = false;
                        setRollover(false, false, true, false);
                    },
                    function () {
                        setRollover(true, false, false, false);
                        autoRoloutEnabled = true;
                    }
                );
                $("#rolloverButtonMusic").hover(
                    function () {
                        autoRoloutEnabled = false;
                        setRollover(false, false, false, true);
                    },
                    function () {
                        setRollover(true, false, false, false);
                        autoRoloutEnabled = true;
                    }
                );
                $("#nextImageButton").hover(
                    function () { $("#nextImageButton").attr("src", "/images/Home/next_btn_hover.gif"); },
                    function () { $("#nextImageButton").attr("src", "/images/Home/next_btn_up.gif"); }
                );

                setInterval(autoRollout, 5000);
            });
        } (jQuery));

        function setRollover(money, mail, video, music) {
            setMoneyActive(money);
            setMailActive(mail);
            setVideoActive(video);
            setMusicActive(music);
        }
        function setMoneyActive(active) {
            if (active) {
                $("#rolloverButtonMoney").attr("src", "/images/Home/money_btn_active.gif");
                $("#rolloverImage").attr("src", "/images/Home/money_hero.jpg");
            } else {
                $("#rolloverButtonMoney").attr("src", "/images/Home/money_btn_inactive.gif");
            }
        }
        function setMailActive(active) {
            if (active) {
                $("#rolloverButtonMail").attr("src", "/images/Home/mail_btn_active.gif");
                $("#rolloverImage").attr("src", "/images/Home/mail_hero.jpg");
            } else {
                $("#rolloverButtonMail").attr("src", "/images/Home/mail_btn_inactive.gif");
            }
        }
        function setVideoActive(active) {
            if (active) {
                $("#rolloverButtonVideo").attr("src", "/images/Home/video_btn_active.gif");
                $("#rolloverImage").attr("src", "/images/Home/video_hero.jpg");
            } else {
                $("#rolloverButtonVideo").attr("src", "/images/Home/video_btn_inactive.gif");
            }
        }
        function setMusicActive(active) {
            if (active) {
                $("#rolloverButtonMusic").attr("src", "/images/Home/music_btn_active.gif");
                $("#rolloverImage").attr("src", "/images/Home/music_hero.jpg");
            } else {
                $("#rolloverButtonMusic").attr("src", "/images/Home/music_btn_inactive.gif");
            }
        }
        function autoRollout() {
            if (!autoRoloutEnabled)
                return;
            if ($("#rolloverButtonMoney").attr("src") == '/images/Home/money_btn_active.gif') {
                setRollover(false, true, false, false);
            } else if ($("#rolloverButtonMail").attr("src") == '/images/Home/mail_btn_active.gif') {
                setRollover(false, false, true, false);
            } else if ($("#rolloverButtonVideo").attr("src") == '/images/Home/video_btn_active.gif') {
                setRollover(false, false, false, true);
            } else if ($("#rolloverButtonMusic").attr("src") == '/images/Home/music_btn_active.gif') {
                setRollover(true, false, false, false);
            }
        }

        /*
        BELOW THREE FUNCTIONS TO TRIM BOTH LEADING AND TRALING SPACES IN THE PASSED STRING
        */
        function trim(str, chars) {
            return ltrim(rtrim(str, chars), chars);
        }
        function ltrim(str, chars) {
            chars = chars || "\\s";
            return str.replace(new RegExp("^[" + chars + "]+", "g"), "");
        }
        function rtrim(str, chars) {
            chars = chars || "\\s";
            return str.replace(new RegExp("[" + chars + "]+$", "g"), "");
        }
    </script>
